details.name: Request
details.value: How do I keep my phone dry on the trail?

details.name: Response
details.value: Pack rain jacket, warm layer, water, food, map, first-aid kit, and dry socks.

details.name: Request
details.value: What should I pack for a rainy day hike?

details.name: Response
details.value: Bring a shell, insulating layer, water, snacks, map, and a dry bag.
